command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=cilium/agent BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=map_inline SAMPLES=3 WORKLOAD_DURATION=60 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image
control_command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=cilium/agent SKIP_REJIT=norejit BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=, SAMPLES=3 WORKLOAD_DURATION=60 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image

derived_counts.note: Every derived value is computed from the retained details/loadtime-reports/cilium__agent.jsonl stream and the retained per-step bytecode in details/loadtime-workdirs/. The paper's declared RQ2 4086 site count is not merged with this fresh 3787 figure.

log_normalization: Guest-console carriage returns and trailing horizontal whitespace normalized in the retained copy.
scope: Fresh local KVM single-pass map_inline run for cilium/agent only, with two matched no-pass controls. It carries both the rewrite reconciliation (122 changed load instances, 3787 applied sites, before/after instruction counts) and the controlled per-pass throughput causality (raw and control-corrected median ratios). SAMPLES=3 at 60 s per sample per the framework's authoritative measurement policy. The paper's June Cilium ratios are a separate generation and are never merged with these numbers.

throughput_causality.metric: median post/baseline summed kernel-pktgen pps over 3+3 samples
throughput_causality.note: The two no-pass controls are matched restarts of the same app at identical 60 s duration with enabled_passes=[], so their spread measures restart drift rather than pass effect. The Cilium workload splits into two kernel-pktgen components per phase, so each phase's throughput is the sum over all components of its pktgen pps scalar.
